mapper.sql: select apply_id, room_id, apply_user_id, apply_dept_id, apply_time, meeting_date, start_time, end_time, meeting_topic, participant_count, participant_list, status, dept_approver_id, dept_approve_time, dept_approve_opinion, admin_approver_id, admin_approve_time, admin_approve_opinion, cancel_time, cancel_reason, del_flag, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from meeting_room_apply
mapper.select: select count(1) from meeting_room_apply where apply_user_id = #{userId} and status in ('1', '2', '3') -- 待审批的状态：已提交、部门审核中、行政复核中 and del_flag = '0'

select mr.room_type as roomType, count(mra.apply_id) as totalApplies, sum(case when mra.status = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as approvedApplies, case when count(mra.apply_id) = 0 then 0 else sum(case when mra.status = '4' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(mra.apply_id) end as successRate from meeting_room_apply mra left join meeting_room mr on mra.room_id = mr.room_id where mra.create_time between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and mra.del_flag = '0' group by mr.room_type
